outcomes.title: Make ordinary execution self-explanatory
outcomes.objective: Share executable action semantics across policy, context and workflow results; make starting, inspecting, validating and finishing work possible without procedural guesswork.
changes: Factor a small canonical assessment/action-policy projection from existing predicates. Derive advertised actions and payload schemas from the same rules that validate execution. Repair capability/role mismatches deliberately.
Add explicit run focus without breaking old calls; return sufficient charter/task/workspace/acceptance context at entry. Ordinary work needs no mandatory follow-up inspection.
Use existing context manifests/deltas with the accepted sync inputs. Budget the complete envelope; a committed claim must remain retrievable if context rendering fails.

Make validation effects explicit; reuse evidence only through the actual complete freshness contract. Remove duplicate gate scheduling for unchanged acceptance inputs. Keep compatibility adapters for previously combined calls.
outcomes.done_when: The public entry/inspect/validate/complete journeys and role/schema consistency tests pass, with no mandatory source-code archaeology or unconditional next-task loops.

outcomes.title: Make safe maintenance a delegable semantic operation
outcomes.objective: Provide bounded resume, amend, supersede/retire and applicability-invalidation operations over existing canonical services; grants follow an approved job rather than the target claim or expensive model.
changes: Use a small typed maintenance mandate and existing audit/authorization storage, not a new permission framework. Validate issuer, principal, operations, target, effect constraints, expiry and revocation. No target-claim dependency for repairing that claim.
Compose existing preparation/recovery/retirement/amendment predicates into one checked ledger transition where possible. Preserve source, exact membership, external consumers and successful history.
For routine approved preparation/clean recovery, execute directly after fresh checks. For new consequential choices, return a bounded decision and resumable operation, not a CLI research assignment.

Handle dirty-work adoption explicitly when not already included in an exact approved mandate. Keep live/unknown process protection and owner-scoped resource cleanup. Reuse existing host sweeps; add only demonstrated lifecycle gaps.

Return canonical replay receipts and truthful stage status across Git/host/ledger boundaries. Re-evaluate safe same-effect contention internally without enlarging reviewed effects or adding a general version-vector system.
outcomes.done_when: A scoped cheaper maintenance operator repairs an eligible interrupted fixture and actual continuation succeeds; unauthorized, ambiguous, live and stale-impact cases remain blocked for the right reason.

outcomes.title: Make delegation and dependency delivery useful
outcomes.objective: Delegate meaningful bounded work with the context and executor it actually needs, and share immutable source deliveries before final qualification without manual provenance reconstruction.
changes: Replace first-file scope guessing with optional explicit targets and deterministic declared-scope defaults. Separate read context from writable sub-scope. Use actual inherited constraints, relevant references and acceptance facts.

Permit equal bounded read scope; support equal/subset write scope only with existing isolated-candidate or enforceable single-writer handoff semantics. Do not remove concurrency protection to satisfy a subset rule.

Distinguish local code children from tool-capable maintenance operators. Create a launch assignment and scoped grant in one handoff; only report launched when the selected configured launcher acknowledges.
Make launch failure, collection, acceptance and cancellation idempotent and accurately annotated. Pending results suggest useful waiting/other work, not repeated immediate polls.

Reuse immutable artifact/workspace receipts for a pinned delivery before completion and explicit consumer import. Qualified dependencies remain separate. Advertise serial versus sealed-batch behavior and preserve interruption-safe provenance.
outcomes.done_when: A delegate gets the correct files/context and a genuine supported launch route, and a sibling can consume an immutable unqualified delivery without pretending the producer is done.

outcomes.title: Bind one working environment and report real capabilities
outcomes.objective: Use the verified runtime consistently and expose supported source, launch and maintenance routes so agents do not reconstruct interpreter/package/authority combinations.
changes: Keep release identity checks; route preview and validation through the same verified runtime as workflow/mutation. Extend existing doctor output with the failing layer and a supported remediation.
Bind existing configured adapters deliberately or mark them unavailable before an attempted delegation. Do not auto-install models or select new paid backends.

Supply a small trusted-launch seam for an available tool-capable agent host, or a ready-to-launch assignment when the host has no callable launcher. Never claim that creating a lane launches a process.
Ensure missing authorities do not trigger implicit bootstrap, restore or database substitution in a read/preview path.
outcomes.done_when: One paired candidate diagnoses and uses the same runtime across public routes, and actual available executor classes match discovery and dispatch.

outcomes.title: Expose concise guidance and specialized maintenance without root rituals
outcomes.objective: Preserve familiar workflow entry points while adding typed defaults, semantic action packets, bounded deep reads and one capability-checked maintenance entry point usable by authorized agents.
changes: Keep the existing six ordinary tool names; add optional parameters and explicit semantic actions rather than a new workflow DSL. Publish action payload shapes/examples so callers need not inspect implementation code.

Expose one specialized maintain_execution surface on appropriate local execution profiles. Authorization is checked per operation/principal; profile visibility or model-supplied role is not authority. Observer mutation remains absent.
Map canonical assessment into frontier, inspection, errors and operation receipts. Give an executable prefilled next call only when one is needed; otherwise say work may proceed.
Use explicit focus, truthful availability/coverage and expandable references. Allow deliberate rich reads directly rather than forcing a workflow-first ritual.
Update instructions/examples and compatibility tests to make ordinary preparation and delegated maintenance normal, with human/root involvement only at real decision boundaries.
outcomes.done_when: Representative agents can use the advertised schemas and returned packets without implementation-source reads, while negative authorization tests still pass.

outcomes.title: Prove low-friction public journeys and hand back paused NF1A
outcomes.objective: Qualify the paired implementation with real public-boundary fixtures, demonstrate fewer avoidable calls and root handoffs, and deliver evidence plus usage without modifying or resuming NF1A.
changes: Exercise the finite acceptance journeys against the real Todo kernel and transport adapters in disposable repositories, with fake clocks/process probes where appropriate and real subprocess-boundary checks for grant transfer.
Measure protocol-call count, caller-supplied fields, model-visible bytes, gate executions and originator handoffs. Treat latency/token savings as unmeasured unless actually measured.
Check all retained PCE1 safety invariants under the revised delegation/ceremony policy. Reuse existing tests; no fixed pass-count quota.
Provide one bounded independent review of grant/transaction/liveness boundaries, actual paired identities, remaining limitations, and a read-only donor readiness handoff.
outcomes.done_when: Every mandatory scenario has current executed evidence, the supported delegated-maintenance route is demonstrated, usage coverage is reported and NF1A remains paused.
